source: The finite Hamiltonian/temporal heat-kernel family of yang-mills-ground-state-transfer.v1.json; no source or vacuum replacement.

quotient.space: X=SU(2)^E / SU(2)^vertices, compact orbit space, including nonfree-action strata.
quotient.measure: mu_X=pi_*mu, not a flat measure on selected loop angles; nu_X=pi_*(Omega^2 mu).
quotient.unitary: pi^*:L2(X,mu_X)->L2(SU(2)^E,mu)^gauge; multiplication by descended Omega gives the weighted-ground-state unitary.
quotient.packet_null: Exact zero evaluation in Haar L2; for smooth packets this is an identically zero function. Form completion requires form-Cauchy representatives, not just L2 convergence.
quotient.nonfree_action: Use measurable equivariant horizontal fields with invariant norm, not an unjustified globally free principal bundle or constant-rank quotient vector bundle.

detector.definition: z_ea=Omega X_ea(psi/Omega), left generators exp(t e_a/2).
detector.vertical_constraint: At vertex v: sum_(source(e)=v) z_e - sum_(target(e)=v) Ad(U_e^-1) z_e = 0.
detector.closed_target: Closed L2 subspace of fields satisfying equivariance and the vertical constraints, with Haar-integrated norm.
detector.domain: Physical H1 form domain; Omega positive smooth with positive minimum at each fixed graph. Closedness follows from the ground-transform form identity.
detector.kernel: Exactly span(Omega); no gauge-orbit or packet-null direction is an additional physical excitation.
detector.energy: q_(H-E0)=kappa*||z||^2 on the full descended form domain.
detector.continuation: Physical semigroup and symmetric transfer steps intertwine pi^* by their gauge symmetry; no form/L2 interchange or volume-uniform comparison is inferred.

strong_hostiles.individual_loop_reader: On the two-loop quotient, (Tr x,Tr y) is not complete: x=i,y=i and x=i,y=j have the same two zero traces but mixed traces -2 and 0.
strong_hostiles.hidden_state: h=Tr(xy)-(Tr x Tr y)/2; conditional expectation given the individual loop traces is zero, but ||h||^2=3/4.
strong_hostiles.electric_energy: On the seven-link source h=F1/2-3F0/2, q0(h)/kappa=15/4, normalized Rayleigh quotient=5*kappa. This is an actual finite-source blind sector, not a low-energy continuum family.
strong_hostiles.flat_measure: For a single SU2 conjugacy angle theta, Haar quotient density is (2/pi)sin(theta)^2, not 1/pi. chi2=4cos(theta)^2-1 has Haar mean0 but flat-angle mean1.
strong_hostiles.scalar_target: Nontrivial adjoint transport changes detector components under gauge transformations even when their norm and physical state are unchanged.

exact_fixture.warning: Omega_test is used only for exact covariance/vertical-constraint controls. It is NOT claimed to be the magnetic ground state.

gate_scope: quotient-descent constructed for the finite source family. Faithful detection with one volume-compatible constant, continuum reconstruction and completion transfer remain open.
